rationale: The base vector returned by find_comparables/get_player_vector is an exact match to an elite 80-Discipline, high-Contact, poor-Defense/Speed profile at a 164 wRC+ / 6.8 WAR level, and the season t+1 vector implied by the delta matches that same player's following season almost exactly (Defense collapsing ~18 points, Contact -6.6 which is only a ~16th-percentile move, Discipline still elite). The fitted regression anchor gave ΔWAR -3.73, ΔwRC+ -28.4, ΔOPS -0.120. I shaded WAR slightly less negative and wRC+ meaningfully less negative than the model, because the still-elite (76) discipline preserves a lot of offensive value even with contact/power erosion — the batting-line drop is driven mostly by AVG/SLG (OPS ~-0.145, larger than the model's -0.12), while wRC+ falls less than the model's -28 since walks hold the floor. The large defensive drop plus offensive regression accounts for roughly a -3.3 WAR swing.
